post.headline: *Boost* Order Speed with WhatsApp Updates
post.subline: Send real‑time order status to diners, cut call volume and increase repeat visits
post.caption:
🚀 Want customers to know their order status instantly? 
Problem: Restaurants lose guests to vague wait times and endless phone calls. 
Fix: Connect your POS to a WhatsApp bot that pushes order ready, delay, and pickup alerts automatically. 
Tip: Start by exporting your POS order feed to a simple CSV and use Zapier to trigger a WhatsApp message for each new status.
